column4: A single small toolbar button icon for a 1998 city-building PC game like SimCity 2000 and RollerCoaster Tycoon: pixel art drawn large with crisp square pixels, dark outline, bright but slightly muted 1990s colours, three-quarter view, centred, filling 80 percent of the canvas. Background must be flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere around it, no text, no border. The icon shows: a square patch of green grass land marked off at its corners by four small wooden stakes with red and white striped tape strung between them, and nothing else on it: no vehicle, no machine, no building, no person.
